inventory_fit_cases.limits: Hypothetical raw source inventory, not actual independently eligible candidate pool. Estimated cards include explicit generic unresolved attribution and source identities, but omit unknown per-source scope/custody/history qualifiers not exported in generation. Not production serializer or fit proof.

design.deep_seam: Extract an OriginalSourcePlan DTO between guarded candidate acquisition and rendering. It owns deduplicated quote transport, size planning, and typed omission accounting. Existing query planner and role/scope/eligibility semantics remain the authority for admission. Claims/episode associations refer to admitted source cards, never cause an original to become a verified fact.
design.why_entirely_absent_sources_could_benefi: Current renderer has separate protected execution/report, selected complete user, neutral user, optional role and inferred-field paths. One globally priced bounded candidate set can retain a source that currently loses a lane cap or competing reservations before a wrapper is emitted. It cannot repair sources excluded by query/hard guards or unseen candidate windows. Existing metadata cannot identify which of43absent anchors fall in each class, so benefit is conditional.
design.candidate_acquisition: Union only currently permitted bounded lanes and explicit same-source evidence IDs; record each admission with owner/query-role/window/guard reason. Do not widen all project/session contents or bypass current historical returns. For sources never in any eligible lane, leave omission unresolved and separately review query intent with public generic regressions.
design.packing: Deduplicate exact source ID+field+interval+role+scope/uncertainty only. Pack whole bounded original cards once, then spend residual budget on independent state/association qualifiers and exact references. Capture sequence ranks display candidates, never factual time or task identity. Use one cost function and deterministic fit/omission accounting; no separate hidden reservations that double-charge shown material.
design.role_fences: Raw user observation stays neutral; current custody disposition/scope remains attached. Assistant report never observed execution. Execution allowlist plus original command, full output, exit code and tool identity remain atomic. Unknown tools remain neutral raw captures. No mixed-source or conflicting-scope merge.
design.canonical_citations: Keep actual source_id,source_field,source_role,start,end and exactquote on one displayed canonical quotation. Only same-source exact field equality can be a mirror; no semantic snippets or cross-event substitutes. Associations keep explicit roles/scope/history/uncertainty. Any compact inheritance needs a versioned schema and catalog compatibility tests, not silent attribute deletion.
design.boundedness: Total6000 including owner split unchanged. Source count/body/field limits stay bounded; unfit atomic groups yield explicit omission. No guarantee that every permissible source fits.
design.minimum_implementation_scope: One internal transport DTO/planner and serializer shared by original-role/user and derived references. Keep Store SQL, query intent and custody lifecycle separate. Start with same existing candidate universe and prove eligibility identity before reviewing acquisition changes.
design.risky_fork_to_avoid: Replacing task memory with an unfiltered project transcript, unioning unrelated scopes, raw-source claims, special gold/event/question routing or model-on-read scoring.

tests_required: Same candidate universe before/after with hard task/project/env/version/session/privacy/deletion/asof guards; source admission audit must prove parity.
Exact all-source roles/quotes and canonical catalog parity with duplicate intervals/differentfields/conflictinguncertainty.
Complete originaluser plus atomictool/report fitting at exact6000/owner2900 boundaries; oversizedgroup omitted intact with truthful bytes/counts.
Currentstate associations remain explicit; originals cannot revive cancelled/deleted requirements or infer closure/identity.
Save bounded pre-render candidate/guard/fit traces outside prompts to determine fullyabsent-source causes in a fresh run.
limits: Disclosed original-source inventories are diagnostic upper bounds, not new quality validation.
Per-source qualifier metadata is not fully present in generation snapshots; card estimates are optimistic and not a promise.

expected_fit_conclusion: Conservative annotated source-card prototype fits all surviving raw originals in27of108owner parts and covers6of47missing-anchor opportunities in those fit parts.81parts exceed the fixed owner budget, including41missing anchors. This is evidence of real capacity limits: deduplication alone cannot promise all-source coverage. Actual per-source scope/custody/history qualifiers may add further cost. A single planner can prevent duplicate charges and reserve a bounded selected coverage set; it cannot eliminate admission filters or make unfit inventories complete.
